name: Mi hoanh thanh
summary: Wonton noodles in the same clear, lightly sweet broth as hủ tiếu, from Tây Ninh’s Hoa kitchens.
origin: Hoa kitchens in Tây Ninh. The cooking is Teochew and Cantonese in origin, adapted to local ingredients.
taste: A clear broth with a light sweetness.
howToEat: Eat it as a bowl, at the same Hoa tables as hủ tiếu and dim sum.
seoTitle: Mi hoanh thanh in Tay Ninh
seoDescription: Mì hoành thánh, wonton noodles in a clear, lightly sweet broth from Tây Ninh’s Hoa kitchens.
